notes: N078_01 — Source statement. The opening says the expression does not change when the roles of g_{i_0} and f are interchanged and writes the displayed quotient relation. The following paragraph calls nu the length of the local artinian intersection of the inserted ss-schémas f(S) and g_{i_0}(S), then mentions an intersection multiplicity. The displayed quotient relation receives the explicit map check recorded below as N078_check_01. The artinian-length and intersection-multiplicity assertions remain reported source statements.

N078_02 — Author’s doubt, transcribed verbatim: "Je présume que l’hom $T_\ell\longrightarrow T_\ell^I/T_\ell$ est le produit par $\mu$ de l’injection canonique $T_\ell-T_\ell^I$, correspondant à l’indice $i_0$." The source then writes: "Il faudrait que je demande à Carlos de me le confirmer." Carlos is retained as the written name; no external identification is made.

N078_03 — Author’s qualification, transcribed verbatim: "Reste le cas $\nu=1$, qui semble demander un traitement séparé." The final paragraph begins Le fait à vérifier and writes a hom. ext. expression and a product expression, ending at où the indexed k/kappa est. The page does not complete that sentence.

N078_04 — Author’s marginal statement, transcribed verbatim: "Ceci doit être indépendant de la valeur de $\nu$ !" The recoverable lower punctuation below the ending of premiers reads "?!"; the older blackened punctuation above it remains tentative.

N078_05 — Diplomatic observations. roles has no secured circumflex. The abbreviation ss-schémas and capital Je are retained. The underline is limited to the ending of premiers. The faint older prose before/under fait is recorded without reconstructing H’s Il/suffit. No autograph page number appears at the head; 77 is secondary margin foliation.

N078_check_01 — Targeted check of the first displayed quotient isomorphism, using the section maps written on scans077–078. Write h*:V→A for the structural map and r=g_{i_0}*:A→V for the section map; r∘h*=id_V. Set J_g=ker r and J_f as on the page. The map α:A/(J_g+J_f)→V/r(J_f), [a]↦[r(a)], is well defined. Its inverse is β:[v]↦[h*(v)]. For j∈J_f, h*r(j)−j belongs to J_g, so β respects the quotient by r(J_f). The composites are αβ([v])=[v] and βα([a])=[h*r(a)]=[a], the last equality following from a−h*r(a)∈J_g. Thus the displayed isomorphism is checked by explicit mutually inverse maps. This check does not establish the asserted artinian length, the presumed inertia homomorphism, or the final nonabelian assertion.
